[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]The %hold prompt directive[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A prompt can arm a durable agent hold with `%hold`, behind the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`agent_holds` beta flag. Python, the Rust typed launch planner, and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the shared editor contract all parse it the same way. Agent and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]proc launches arm the hold when they are submitted, excluding their[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]own kin and getting a priority boost. Approval previews list what [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]each hold captures, broad holds need interactive confirmation, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`%hold` is rejected when combined with `%repeat` or `%dispatch`.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]directive-surface[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]directive-surface: create the agent_holds beta flag. Add a Rust [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-directive collector with a canonical formatter and a selector [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expansion, plus the `hold` contract entry and the new Hood value role. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Parse %hold into the typed agent and proc unit wires, including [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]previews, the dispatch-prompt re-render, and plan-time diagnostics for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]self holds, cycles, %repeat and %dispatch. Route Python directive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parsing through the same collector.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Arm holds at launch submission[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]arm-runtime[dim] · [dim][/dim]after directive-surface[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]arm-runtime: extend the Rust hold store with a pending-launch armer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kind, arm-time rejection of the armer's own and kin names, and an armer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rebind that keeps the record's timing. Arm from the agent runner [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bootstrap and from typed-plan submission, rebind the hold when a unit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatches, release units that never dispatch, and apply the implied [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]armer priority.[/#D7D7AF]
